summary: Poland, software developer, experience with C++, Python, Qt, and game development, strong advocate for free and open-source software (FOSS), active in XMPP and Matrix communities, prefers KDE Plasma over GNOME, uses Maemo and Nokia N900, enjoys coding on-the-go, interested in environmental issues and veganism, has a partner who is a vegetarian, participates in game jams, has developed multiple small games, critical of big tech companies, values privacy and data security, prefers using privacy-focused tools like DuckDuckGo and Signal, has a strong interest in mobile operating systems and their development.
